mechanics.claim: Sylas casting an ability generates a stack, refreshing on subsequent casts.
mechanics.quote: Whenever '''Sylas''' casts an {{tip|ability}}, he generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Unshackled'' for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts

mechanics.claim: Next basic attack consumes a stack and is uncancellable, applying the passive damage.
mechanics.quote: is empowered to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}} and consume a stack to whirl his chains around him

mechanics.claim: Stacks are only granted at the end of the ability's cast time, not on cast start.
mechanics.quote: ''Unshackled'' stacks are granted at the end of the abilities' cast time.

mechanics.claim: If duration is under 0.5s remaining and an attack begins, duration refreshes to 1s to avoid expiring mid-windup.
mechanics.quote: If ''Unshackled'' has less than {{fd|0.5}} seconds remaining and '''Sylas''' begins an attack, its duration will refresh to 1 second to prevent it from expiring during the windup.

mechanics.claim: Spellblade-style damage does not convert to magic and only hits the primary target.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spellblade}} damage does not get converted to magic damage, and will deal its damage only to the primary target.

mechanics.claim: Basic damage applies to primary target, area damage to secondary targets.
mechanics.quote: Applies {{tip|basic damage}} to the primary target and {{tip|area damage}} to secondary targets.

mechanics.claim: Only the primary target's damage can critically strike.
mechanics.quote: ''Petricite Burst's'' damage cannot critically strike against secondary targets.

mechanics.claim: On-hit effects only apply to the primary target.
mechanics.quote: ''Petricite Burst'' only applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects to the primary target.

mechanics.claim: The attack benefits from life steal.
Secondary-target minions that would drop below 25 health are executed.
mechanics.quote: executes {{tip|minions}} that are secondary targets and would be left below {{sti|{{as|25 health}}}}
